class.name: GameplayMultiplayerReplication
class.brief_description: Godot MultiplayerPeer adapter for gameplay RPC and replication policy.
class.description: Binds transport-independent RPC, property, and optional [GameplayReplicationGraph] policies to an existing Godot multiplayer peer. Server inbound calls require the actual transport sender to be a spawned [GameplaySessionManager] connection and optionally the server-recorded gameplay owner. Clients accept authority calls and state only from peer 1. Connection views are installed only by trusted server code; a client relevancy-control envelope is rejected. The adapter uses reliable channel 1, rejects packets over 1200 bytes, and explicitly fragments large state transfers.

method.name: clear_transport
method.description: Detaches the peer and clears in-progress reassembly state without removing registered policy.

method.name: configure_client
method.description: Attaches a client peer. Incoming authority packets must have transport sender 1.

method.name: configure_server
method.description: Attaches a server peer and the authoritative connection lifecycle source.

method.name: get_object_owner_peer_id
method.description: Returns locally registered gameplay ownership. Network authority remains separate.

method.name: set_object_dormant
method.description: On a configured server, changes graph dormancy and captures the bound state's current change serial.

method.name: set_replication_graph
method.description: Installs a graph before transport setup or on a configured server. Configured clients are rejected.

method.name: update_server_connection_view
method.description: Adds or updates an authoritative view only when the adapter is a server and the peer is a spawned gameplay connection.

method.name: wake_object
method.description: Explicitly wakes a graph object on the configured server.

method.name: get_rejected_packet_count
method.description: Returns the number of rejected RPC or replication packets.

method.name: handles_message
method.description: Returns whether a decoded envelope belongs to this adapter.

method.name: invoke_rpc
method.description: Invokes a registered RPC according to its local direction policy. Owner targets are resolved locally; client targets must be admitted connections.

method.name: receive_packet
method.description: Validates and dispatches a decoded adapter envelope. The sender argument must come from [method MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_peer], never message data.

method.name: register_object
method.description: Registers a stable network object ID, its gameplay owner, and optional property state.

method.name: register_rpc
method.description: Adds one allowlisted RPC and its local handler.

method.name: replicate
method.description: On a configured server, collects and sends eligible dirty state to all spawned sessions.

method.name: set_object_owner_peer_id
method.description: Changes locally authoritative gameplay ownership without changing Godot multiplayer authority.

method.name: unregister_object
method.description: Removes an object, its state binding, and its RPC allowlist.

members.member: Fragmentation limits and reassembly runtime used by this endpoint.
Optional server-side relevancy and budget scheduler. Without it, the GF-3 behavior of considering every registered object is preserved.
Machine-readable reason for the most recent rejected packet or local authority violation.
Whether the adapter is configured as the authoritative endpoint.

signal.name: replication_applied
signal.description: Emitted after a complete valid transfer is applied.

signal.name: replication_failed
signal.description: Emitted when state validation or reassembly fails.

signal.name: object_became_irrelevant
signal.description: Emitted when an object leaves a server connection's exact relevant set.

signal.name: object_became_relevant
signal.description: Emitted when an object enters a server connection's exact relevant set.

signal.name: relevancy_rejected
signal.description: Emitted when a peer attempts to control server relevancy.

signal.name: rpc_received
signal.description: Emitted after an allowlisted handler runs.

signal.name: rpc_rejected
signal.description: Emitted when sender, lifecycle, ownership, direction, target, or payload validation fails.
